relationship_to_prior_patch: Incremental on GitLab main after merge request !38 (patch 0013). Do not reapply earlier patches.
reported: Diplomacy and leaderhead research: make AI opponents competent in deals, war and peace

root_causes.power_overflow: team power reaches 10^5+ in later eras (unit power up to 2100); 32-bit power products in AI_endWarVal, AI_surrenderTrade, AI_considerOffer and the paranoia term overflowed; capitulation was refused once both powers passed ~33,000
root_causes.received_resource: a received resource was valued with iChange -1 (a spare copy, a fifth of its value)
root_causes.ai_resource_swaps: AI-to-AI resource swaps had no value check
root_causes.peace_gold: AI_doPeace counted gold 1:1 while AI_dealVal prices it at AI_goldTradeValuePercent (2-3 value per gold)
root_causes.war_hire: the second war-hire tech was compared with the first tech's best value
root_causes.embargo: AI_stopTradingTradeVal priced all of the target's cancellable deals, not those with the embargoed team
root_causes.thresholds: give-help and tribute thresholds were read from the other player's leader
root_causes.personality: favourite religion and espionage weight were read from the leader, not the personality
root_causes.victory_flag: AI_getCloseBordersAttitude tested AI_VICTORY_CONQUEST3 against the strategy bits (bit 7 = AI_STRATEGY_FINAL_WAR)
root_causes.capitulation: AI_acceptSurrender required >= MaxWarRand/100 valuable cities; for MaxWarRand < 100 the bound was 0 and every capitulation was refused
root_causes.attitude_cache: memories and peacetime grants did not refresh the attitude cache; team counters advanced at turn rollover while member attitude caches were cleared only at the end of each player's next turn (attitudes lagged a turn; a reloaded game played differently)
root_causes.async_roll: the 'do not bother' path of AI_beginDiplomacy rolled the asynchronous generator in the synchronous AI turn
root_causes.vassal_tribute: AI vassals were never asked about tribute (only human vassals)
root_causes.missing_deal_shapes: the AI never offered a tech for gold or gold per turn for a resource

validation.new_test_against_base: all 14 test cases fail (13 failures, 1 error: scaleByRatio undefined)
validation.real_dll_harness: research/diplomacy: corrected harness campaign, 0013 vs 0014 on Mediterranean and Earth 12 WorldBuilder scenarios (Epic 300 turns, Marathon 590 turns), and the save/reload determinism check
